verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static ES|QL REST API documentation, such as request-body parameters like `time_zone`, `locale`, and `format`. Nothing documents an interactive API reference or runnable, try-it-now examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Static parameter docs are an adjacent feature and earn no credit toward an interactive, runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
